column1: # Italian (it) catalog. Same format as zh-hant.tsv:  context <TAB> source <TAB> translation
# (empty context = a plain UI string; `@id` = a command id; `@plural` = "one|other" forms).
# Clean-room: written from the meaning of TerraZone's English labels in standard Italian, using the
# feature names Italian users of vector illustration software know (Tavola da disegno, Campioni, Traccia,
# Riempimento, Tracciato, Punto di ancoraggio, Penna, Selezione diretta, Elaborazione tracciati, Motivo,
# Preset). No other application's Italian localisation was copied. Labels use sentence case (only the
# first word capitalised); commands use the imperative (Apri, Salva, Mostra) and sentences address the
# user as "tu". Shortcut keys keep their key-cap names (Shift, Alt, Ctrl, Esc).
# Coverage: the whole interface — every menu string and every `tl!` literal (`complete_menus`,
# tested). Left in English on purpose (`MENU_KEEP_AS_IS` in the tests): the product name, language
# names, OpenType, the built-in workspace names and the bracketed perspective grid preset names.
# Photoshop-style raster effects (Effect menu, their dialogs).
# Status and error messages too (`@msg` rows at the end, `COMPLETE_MESSAGES` in the tests).
# A native speaker's review is welcome: keep the placeholders ({name}), the trailing "…" and the
# leading/trailing spaces of fragments exactly as they are.
# Leading model (Paragraph panel menu, East Asian options).
# Status and error messages (`@msg`), translated where the status bar shows them; the message itself
# stays English for agents and tests. `{_1}`, `{_2}` … stand for the `{}` of the format string, in order
# (`complete_languages_translate_every_message` lists any that are missing). Command ids, parameter
# names and values in backticks or code (`colorModel rgb`, `document.export`) stay as they are.
# The macOS menu bar (native_menu): the app and Window menus' system items, Settings pages.
